NAME

crypto_policy_t

SYNOPSIS

#include <include/ascii-chat/crypto/policy.h>

Data Fields


bool transport_secure
bool encrypt
bool no_encrypt
bool no_auth
bool has_password
bool has_identity
bool has_verification_key

Detailed Description

Transport-independent inputs shared by native, WASM, and mobile callers. TLS/DTLS protect the transport. Keys request authentication, not encryption. Explicit no-encrypt wins over the password default, enabling auth-only.
